title: TechCorp VPN Setup Instructions
content:
## VPN Connection Steps

1. Download and install the SecureConnect VPN client
2. Open SecureConnect and click [Connect to Workspace]
3. Enter server address: vpn.techcorp.io
4. Log in with your TechCorp email and password
5. Select [Split Tunnel Mode] to connect

## Common Issues
- Connection timeout: Verify network connectivity and ensure firewall allows VPN port (443)
- Authentication failure: Check password expiration; reset at https://auth.techcorp.io
- Cannot reach internal resources: Try reconnecting or call IT support ext.7777

## Important Notes
- VPN password syncs with email password, expires every 60 days
- International travel requires advance VPN permission request

title: New Hire Technology Equipment Request
content:
## Request Workflow

1. Access HR Portal - Equipment - New Device Request
2. Complete form (requires manager sign-off)
3. IT processes within 3 business days
4. Notification sent when device is ready for pickup

## Standard Equipment Package
- Laptop: Dell Latitude 15 or MacBook Pro 13-inch
- Monitor: LG 24-inch Full HD
- Peripherals: Keyboard and mouse (budget up to 400 CNY)
- Mobile: Based on role requirements

## Important Notes
- All equipment must be returned upon termination
- Report damaged equipment through repair workflow
- Software installation requires IT approval

title: Working From Home Policy and Tools
content:
## Remote Work Requirements

1. Connect via company VPN for internal system access (refer to VPN Setup kb_101)
2. Maintain availability on DingTalk during core hours
3. Participate in daily team check-in (09:30)

## Approved Tools
- Messaging: DingTalk (mandatory), Slack (optional)
- Documents: SharePoint + Office 365
- Development: GitHub Enterprise (VPN required for internal repos)
- Meetings: Microsoft Teams (preferred), WebEx (external meetings)

## Network Standards
- Minimum bandwidth: Download 30Mbps+ / Upload 5Mbps+
- Video calls need stable connection
- Unstable home network? Apply for hotspot allowance (80 CNY/month)

## Security Guidelines
- Avoid sensitive work on public networks
- Enable auto-lock after 3 minutes
- No recording of internal meetings without authorization

title: Time Off and Leave Management
content:
## Vacation Allowance
- 1 year tenure: 7 days
- 3 years tenure: 12 days
- 5 years tenure: 18 days

## Request Procedure
1. Submit via HR Portal
2. Manager approval required
3. 5+ days needs director approval

## Key Points
- Submit vacation requests 5 business days ahead
- Carry over maximum 3 unused days annually
- Medical leave requires doctor's note

title: Account Security and Password Management
content:
## Password Requirements
- Minimum length: 14 characters
- Must contain: uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols
- Expiration: 60 days
- History: Cannot repeat last 6 passwords

## Reset Options
1. Self-service: Go to https://auth.techcorp.io
2. Through DingTalk IT assistant
3. Call IT support ext.7777

## Two-Factor Authentication
- 2FA required for all corporate systems
- Preferred app: Google Authenticator
- Fallback: Email verification code

## Lockout Policy
- 3 failed attempts locks account for 15 minutes
- Self-unlock available or contact IT support

title: VPN Client Migration Announcement
content:
## Critical Update

Per IT Security Board decision, SecureConnect VPN client will be discontinued effective April 15, 2026.

**New Client:**
Migrate to NetGuard VPN client (Cisco AnyConnect).

**Migration Process:**
1. Remove SecureConnect
2. Install NetGuard from https://vpn.techcorp.io/client
3. Use same server address and login credentials

**Important:** This announcement supersedes the SecureConnect guide in kb_101. For assistance, contact IT support ext.7777.

Note: kb_101 will be revised once migration concludes.

title: Remote Work Troubleshooting Guide
content:
## Common Remote Work Issues

### VPN Connection Problems
- Verify internet connectivity first
- Check if VPN client is latest version
- Try switching between WiFi and ethernet
- See VPN Setup (kb_101) and Migration Notice (kb_106)

### Application Access Issues
- Confirm VPN is actively connected
- Clear browser cache and cookies
- Try incognito/private browsing mode
- Reference Remote Work Policy (kb_103)

### Audio/Video Problems
- Test microphone and camera in settings
- Close unnecessary applications
- Reduce video quality if bandwidth is limited

## When to Contact IT
- Issues persist after following troubleshooting steps
- Error messages you don't understand
- Need emergency access during off-hours

Contact: IT support ext.7777 or email itsupport@techcorp.io
